description: Billing-unit account totals deterministically compute gross, discounts, net total, paid, pending, remaining and available amounts.

Advanced order/account frontend contract exposes order item versions, a PASS/KITCHEN_ADMIN returnable-item RPC, pending cancellation state and a database trigger that blocks duplicate return cancellation requests.
Order allergen snapshot is derived from non-removed ingredients; removing an authorized removable ingredient removes its allergens from the immutable order snapshot.
Audit rows cannot be updated/deleted.
Verify Super Admin can read the full audit search while Admin and lower roles cannot access the technical audit view.
Audit JSON contains no known sensitive secret-key fields.
Authenticated SECURITY DEFINER routines that mutate data must contain or delegate an explicit authorization guard.
Authenticated SECURITY DEFINER RPCs that mutate data have an application authorization guard; heuristic exceptions are manually reviewed.
Authenticated clients cannot directly mutate dish availability.
Backup replication retries platform rate limits using provider retry timing and still completes with verified primary/replica integrity.
Beta documentation gate requires BETA_STATUS.md in addition to the mandatory technical documentation set and fails closed until source-backed verification exists.
Beta readiness is separated from Production go-live; real Stripe/Satispay and Epson hardware remain visible non-blocking Beta external gates while software/source/PWA blockers fail closed.
Booking pacing enforces service covers, per-slot arrivals and per-slot covers while excluding cancelled/no-show capacity.
Authoritative category/ingredient/station/dish CRUD supports draft→composition→activation, venue override, immutable base/local price history and in-use archive guards.
Chain-level privacy/retention configuration is reachable by an authorized ADMIN CHAIN without granting restaurant-admin settings to SUPER_ADMIN.
CI cannot start staging or production runs until the corresponding environment release gates are explicitly PASS.
CI stages enforce ordering, terminal failure and release gate before production.
Successful PRODUCTION CI stage records application release using the schema-valid RELEASED status.
service_role can drive the CI state machine but cannot insert a production release directly.

Command Palette searches operational resources only for an unlocked authorized staff session, enforces venue scope for non-global roles, includes Admin settings, preserves invoker/RLS semantics and returns no data for unauthorized venues.
All operational Command Palette navigation paths are internal /staff paths; clients reject any returned path outside the staff namespace.
Admin-only Conflict Center exposes venue/resource/user/device/local+sync times/reason/server snapshot/requested operation/safe actions and resolution rejects the original offline event with audit.
Backup/restore/cron continuity requirements pass.
All Plateform cron jobs are unique, active and their operational schedules/results are reviewed; newly introduced retention cron remains fail-safe until configured.
Lower operational role cannot execute administrative action.
VENUE-scoped user cannot read or invoke another venue.
Public customer mutations are audited as CUSTOMER while preserving null staff identity and avoiding sensitive customer fields.
Customer access code has persistent backoff/rate limiting.
Database regression gate passes.

Internal Edge chaos harness forces the database transport to fail before a service-role mutation request, verifies explicit failure and zero mutation, then proves the same mutation succeeds with healthy transport and cleans the sentinel.
Public Data API exposure is explicit: migration-owner defaults do not grant clients automatically, authenticated table grants are read-only, and anon table exposure is narrowly RLS-scoped.
Technical privacy retention engine is fail-safe while unconfigured, uses explicit retention settings, protected configuration, scheduled execution and auditable anonymization/deletion.
Discount quote correctly computes fixed, percentage, item complimentary and account complimentary amounts and rejects discounts beyond unpaid balance.
All required documentation working drafts exist, are non-empty, explicitly marked DRAFT and contain no obvious hardcoded secrets/tokens before source-control versioning.
The final documentation set is tracked item-by-item and can only be verified by service-role automation; release gate remains pending until all required documents pass.
Required documentation cannot pass the release gate unless it references a versioned Git Markdown source and has verification evidence.
Duplicate provider event is idempotent.
Edge Function logs are reviewed for current-version 5xx regressions and continuity worker health.
Edge Function source and runtime logs contain no hardcoded provider keys, bearer tokens or JWTs; provider secrets are read from environment.
All live Edge Functions have reviewed authentication/public exposure, bounded input, server-side authorization or retired tombstone behavior.

Synthetic rollback-only Super Admin AAL2 session uses the real save_feature_license and create_venue RPCs with one-time FEATURE_CHANGE grants; second venue is created idempotently/audited and unsafe disable with two active venues is rejected.
Server-side food cost selects venue cost over chain fallback and computes theoretical margin deterministically.
A concurrent ingredient-cost update does not alter an in-flight analytics statement; subsequent analytics sees the committed new cost.
Food-cost snapshots preserve historical values across cost changes and are immutable.
Exceptional account closure cannot bypass force-close controls: normal close requires settled balance, while force-close requires ADMIN and a resource-bound FORCE_CLOSE step-up grant.
Verify force-close and reopen account end-to-end with ADMIN authorization, one-time step-up grants, customer-session revocation and audit.

Full-auth duration supports fixed minutes or planned-shift end, persists the computed expiry in the staff session, keeps PIN unlock bounded by that expiry, and is configured only by CHAIN Admin with step-up.
Same idempotency key and payload replays the stored response; mismatched payload is rejected.
Super Admin impersonation is read-only until explicit write enablement, and impersonated writes are audited.
Ingredient cost writes are ADMIN-authorized, idempotent and audited with economic fields.
Initial setup remains required until restaurant profile, first active venue and at least one active ADMIN exist; Super Admin can read the resumable setup phase without exposing secrets.
Operational Health records fresh, truthful component states and never marks unverified external integrations healthy.
Only one device can consume the last available portion.
All explicit Master Prompt acceptance requirements across Unit, Integration, E2E, Chaos, Audit, Security and additional acceptance cases are individually tracked and evidenced.
Menu editor is idempotent, versioned, keeps public QR identity stable and atomically rewrites venue/category/dish assignments.
Menu engineering classification deterministically maps popularity/margin quadrants while retaining numeric metrics.
Menu engineering reuses billing-unit semantics, excludes voided units and returns period sales plus theoretical food cost, margin and classification.

Venue Admin can configure and publish a single-venue menu with stable public_menu_id and venue-scoped promotion; public payload resolves categories/promotions and admin workspace exposes the permanent public URL.
Expired promotions are excluded server-side and promotions cannot alter authoritative dish pricing.
Menu scheduling supports date/day/time windows including overnight service ranges.

Menus can be associated with restaurant services through a normalized join table; public availability requires an active matching service schedule when associations exist, and v2 Admin RPCs save associations atomically.
The same shared catalog dish is rendered with venue-specific local price and availability, while venue-specific enabled=false hides a dish without cloning the catalog.
Verified reservation messaging contacts are channel-scoped; EMAIL can operate under RESERVATION_MESSAGING alone and explicit opt-out suppresses destination resolution.
Provider delivery callbacks transition SENT to DELIVERED idempotently and do not duplicate provider events.
Message delivery claim/lease lifecycle retries transient failures with backoff and deduplicates provider events.
Message worker leases jobs, retries only known failures with backoff, deduplicates provider events and reaches DELIVERED without duplicate state transitions.
Message delivery uses leased retries, exponential backoff and idempotent provider delivery events.
A terminal messaging failure does not modify or lose the authoritative reservation state.
Reservation confirmation outbox enqueues exactly one message job per enabled channel and repeat processors do not duplicate it.
Reservation message outbox remains pending with explicit error when no licensed operational channel is available.
Mock provider integration exercises claim, retry/backoff, provider idempotency and delivery callback processing.
Expired/unknown send outcomes require reconciliation and cannot be automatically reclaimed for resend.
Certain provider failure retries the same message job with backoff; successful delivery and duplicate provider events are idempotent.
Queued message jobs freeze the selected template so later template edits do not alter already queued communication.
Reservation message templates accept only approved customer-facing variables and reject internal/arbitrary placeholders.
Unknown remote messaging outcomes enter UNKNOWN and are not automatically resent, preventing duplicate delivery risk.
Unknown remote messaging outcome is never retried blindly and requires reconciliation without altering the reservation.
Reservation message worker accepts the internal Vault-backed worker token, is scheduled server-side and returns HTTP 200 without exposing raw secrets.
Messaging worker deduplicates provider events, retries known temporary failures, and reconciles unknown outcomes without blind resend.
Messaging provider failure schedules retry or terminal failure without mutating or losing the reservation.
Duplicate migration names are reviewed: versions must remain unique and differently named-history entries must not be rewritten.
Second active venue rejected while MULTI_VENUE is disabled.
Pure page/route navigation is recorded in telemetry without creating a security audit event.

Notification Center uses real staff authorization, filters by venue/role/user, expires stale notifications, transitions NEW to ACKNOWLEDGED to RESOLVED, keeps active inbox clean and audits acknowledgement/resolution.
Authenticated staff can obtain a server-issued HMAC-signed offline authorization snapshot bound to the active device/session/venues without exposing service_role or signing secrets to the client.
Expired offline authorization rejects operation as conflict.
Revoked offline device is rejected on reconnect.
A valid offline snapshot is rejected as a conflict if the user is revoked before synchronization, with no domain mutation applied.
A staff user cannot perform assignment-scoped operations on an unassigned table/station/resource.
Provider payments cannot be manually confirmed by staff RPC.
Authenticated clients cannot directly mutate payment status.
Completed provider operations ignore late WAITING callbacks and reject contradictory terminal callbacks without regressing state.
Critical operational tables have no uncovered foreign-key indexes and no known duplicate indexes remain.
API grants match the permission manifest.
Plateform is checked against Supabase PostgreSQL 17.11 breaking-change conditions for pgcrypto, ltree, btree_gist and custom operators.
Client-supplied price fields are rejected and order pricing remains server-authoritative.
Printer failure is retained and retry requires duplicate-risk confirmation.
Automatic staff print consumer only sees queued EPOS/BRIDGE jobs for active devices allowed to the current role; BROWSER jobs remain manual and role-forbidden devices are hidden.
Privacy search/export/rectification/anonymization routines are reviewed for venue authorization, role boundaries, step-up protection, idempotency and audit.
Data retention is disabled by default, scheduled safely, service-role executed, and cannot purge data until an explicit customer policy is configured.
Venue admin cannot escalate role or CHAIN scope.
Promotion editor is idempotent and versioned; expiry removes the promotion from public payload without altering authoritative dish price.
Unknown remote outcome reuses same provider operation on retry.
Anonymous booking availability is computed server-side from service schedule, pacing, closures, large-party policy and deposit policy without exposing internal reservation counts.
Anonymous menu access by stable QR id or slug exposes only categories/dishes authorized for that menu and venue.

Public reservation Edge accepts RESERVED, REQUESTED and PENDING_DEPOSIT responses; reservation-deposit returns to /prenota; both public Edge endpoints are reachable and reject invalid payloads with application-level 400 responses.
Public site branding contract supports philosophy and chef content with bounded text, HTTPS-only chef imagery, accessible alt text and explicit section visibility controls.

Public waitlist Edge derives join and acceptance rate-limit identity server-side from the trusted client IP, does not accept a browser-supplied rate key, validates bounded JSON input and remains reachable without JWT while preserving application-level validation.
Release readiness becomes false when any core health component is degraded or stale.
Authoritative snapshot repairs state after lost Realtime event.
Recipe units convert deterministically and incompatible dimensions fail closed.
Verify refund end-to-end with ADMIN authorization, one-time step-up grant, idempotency, ledger update and audit.
Release 4 commercial modules are globally licensed and venue-enabled server-side; unlicensed modules fail closed and public payloads hide disabled features.
Reservation reminder scheduler reuses the same dedupe-key job across retries and repeated scheduler runs.
Reminder scheduler deduplicates retries, replaces stale schedules after booking-time changes and cancels pending reminders when the reservation leaves RESERVED.
A RESERVED reservation creates one transactional outbox event and one deduplicated message job; repeated outbox processing does not duplicate the job.
Reservation deposit provider callbacks verify provider authenticity and server-side payment facts before applying authoritative deposit state.
Deposit provider callback deduplicates provider events and rejects contradictory/out-of-order callbacks after completion.
Public reservation-deposit Edge Function is deployed and returns controlled validation errors instead of runtime failures.
Expired pending deposits atomically expire their reservation, revoke access and release booking capacity.
Booking deposit policy is evaluated server-side; required fixed deposits enter PENDING_DEPOSIT with opaque access token, feature-gate fail closed and large-group precedence.
Reservation deposit completion is service-role-only and atomically confirms the reservation; client roles cannot mark deposits paid.
Reservation deposit lifecycle enforces valid transitions, immutability and audit.
Reservation confirmation outbox creates exactly one delivery job per enabled channel and repeated processors do not duplicate it.
Message destination and template payload PII remain in private schema and are not exposed through public message job rows.
Internal worker token reaches reservation-message-worker Edge Function and the worker can call the service-role-only claim RPC without exposing a public execution path.
Unified reservation messaging cron executes outbox, reminder scheduling and worker dispatch without duplicate cron topology.
Reservation messaging cron is active, no-ops safely when no work exists, and invokes the worker only for due jobs.

A NO_SHOW snapshots the configured deposit action; MANUAL and RETAIN never call a provider, while FULL/PARTIAL create an idempotent queued refund amount without changing deposit refund state before provider confirmation.

No-show deposit refunds are leased to a service-only provider worker, only mutate deposit refunded state after verified provider completion, poll known remote refund ids safely and require reconciliation for unknown outcomes.
No-show engine never marks before grace; SUGGESTED creates one Host notification after grace; AUTOMATIC transitions RESERVED to NO_SHOW server-side with audit and correction path.
Reminder scheduler reuses the same dedupe key on repeated runs and cancels stale reminders when the reservation schedule changes.
Reminder scheduler enqueues once, reuses an existing dedupe key on repeat runs and keeps reservation state unchanged.
Reminder scheduler and delivery worker keep one logical reminder across retries, with stable dedupe and no duplicate scheduler enqueue.
All application public/private tables have RLS enabled.
Advanced room editor can create room/zone/layout, save versioned elements and tables, activate layout and enforces in-use/archive guards with rollback-only fixtures.
Every application SECURITY DEFINER function has an explicit search_path configuration.
Restaurant services are arbitrary ADMIN-managed records with name, start/end time, weekdays, active state and booking/covers capacity; no lunch/dinner-only assumption exists.
Revoked/mismatched sessions fail closed.
Shift management is ADMIN-only planning with staff/start/end/version, overlap and timezone guards, and contains no attendance, clock-in/out, lateness or break tracking.
A second restaurant/customer profile cannot be created in the same installation.

Staff identifiers use the dedicated stable identity domain, normalize display names, resolve collisions as base2/base3 without coupling to public/staff URL changes, and check both Auth users and pending create jobs.
Staff logout explicitly revokes the current operational staff_session and writes AUTH_LOGOUT audit evidence; repeated calls are idempotent.
Staff PIN requires password after lockout threshold.
Validate venue/service/date/party association and all bookable slot invariants
Verify real booking DOM with Chromium and isolated mock transport for filter invalidation, out-of-order response and payload submission
PostgreSQL Europe/Rome spring-forward non-existent local slot suppression; adjacent valid slots and ordinary-day availability stay intact
Isolated TypeScript client: dynamic booking field UUID IDs, JSONB-compatible select/radio/checkbox payloads, required field and numeric validation
Ensure booking readiness, navigation, public site and SEO booking page agree for every active venue
Pure TypeScript contrast tests for ten representative administrator-defined accents, fallback background contrast, text and visible focus
Chromium CSS checks for light/dark button contrast, mobile touch target, keyboard focus, reduced motion and form input readability
Integrated frontend payment redirects accept only exact provider checkout hosts, never arbitrary brand subdomains
Isolated TypeScript client: reservation/deposit response validation and constrained Stripe/Satispay HTTPS redirects
Pure client contract for deposits: redirect HTTPS provider allowlist, id/provider context, completed/failed/processing states
Rebuild deployed public tree from real Vite HTML template with controlled anonymous RPC, stale-route cleanup and noindex mode
Source recovered from authorized full Plateform checkpoint; public booking uses authoritative server availability, dates, idempotency and deposit Edge Function; offline unit assertions
Recovered full application public menu mobile navigation tested in actual Chromium DOM without backend
Recovered full application static public HTML SEO renderer tested with mocked public RPC data, escaping, origin and key checks
Actual assembled prerendered HTML in Chromium with JavaScript disabled: home, menu, contacts, keyboard and CSS responsive/contrast
Read-only PostgreSQL migration inventory recovery with strict SHA-256, dry-run, mismatch and malicious input guards
Client side booking CTA and multi-venue selection respect authoritative selected venue booking readiness
Booking readiness requires HTTPS privacy notice and active configured service; all public booking RPCs obey same backend policy
Real development PostgreSQL booking writes for RESERVED, REQUESTED, PENDING_DEPOSIT, idempotent replay, deposit row and full rollback
Reject browser credentials with service_role or sb_secret while accepting supported publishable and legacy anon keys
Check public page metadata, anonymous scope, forbidden routes, SEO noindex behavior
Chromium DOM test for aria-expanded, Escape focus restoration, outside clicks, link close, responsive desktop transition and handler cleanup
Check sitemap candidate URLs, private route exclusion and indexability consistency
Local release compiler recognizes the actual index.html Vite entry with its boot paragraph and produces accessible static HTML; rejects multiple or injected app mounts
Staging workflow requires Node 24 npm ci, formatting, full app checks, Chromium E2E, migration dry run, real build and hosted HTTPS smoke
Staging HTTPS read-only smoke contract on controlled HTTP fixtures with explicit negative tests
Public HTML editorial fallback built from authorized read-only RPC payloads: home/story, menu published vs legacy, gallery, contacts, venues, strict escaping and build consistency
Chromium with JavaScript disabled renders SSR editorial markup, menu/allergens and contact links without running injected HTML
Pre-render indexable public route HTML metadata, sitemap.xml and robots.txt from authoritative read-only Supabase RPCs; fail closed on malformed URLs or mismatched domains
Vercel staging headers, noindex, staff route segregation, and no-asset-fallback tests on the integrated source
Step-up grants are bound to user/session/action/resource, expire, and are single-use.
Client roles cannot directly write Storage objects.
Application policies and routines do not use deprecated auth.role() or user-editable user_metadata for authorization.
Supabase security advisor findings are reviewed and either remediated, documented as intentional deny-all/public API, or tracked as an external go-live gate.
Super Admin privileged authorization requires AAL2.
Takeaway ordering reuses the core place_order stock lock and never permits availability to go negative.
Takeaway tickets are visible in KDS without a table and show the pickup-time service label.
Takeaway pickup slot is locked server-side; only capacity_orders non-cancelled orders can occupy the slot.

Takeaway operational status follows kitchen truth: preparation requires started items, ready requires all active items READY/SERVED, and collection serves items/steps and removes the ticket from active KDS.
Incident and incident-event visibility is limited to SUPER_ADMIN and venue ADMIN scope; operational roles cannot read technical incident data.
Tip validation rejects negative tips; a completed manual payment persists the tip exactly once without increasing account debt.
Two registers cannot reserve the same outstanding balance.
Required variant groups, max selection limits and valid variant snapshots are enforced transactionally without leaking failed orders.
With MULTI_VENUE disabled and exactly one active venue, staff venue context auto-opens the sole authorized venue and never shows a selector.
With MULTI_VENUE enabled, a user assigned to multiple active venues sees a selector, can persist an authorized operational venue and cannot select a venue after authorization is removed.
With MULTI_VENUE enabled, a VENUE-scoped user assigned to exactly one active venue auto-opens it without a selector.
Supplying a foreign venue_id to an authorized RPC does not bypass CHAIN/VENUE scope enforcement.
Public waitlist Edge Function is deployed and returns controlled validation errors without exposing privileged DB APIs.
Two accepted waitlist offers competing for the final capacity are serialized on the service lock; only one converts to a reservation.
Expired waitlist offers transition to EXPIRED, revoke the offer token and are processed by scheduled expiry runner.

When Admin enables waitlist offer messaging, offering a compatible waitlist entry atomically queues phone-based WAITLIST_OFFER message jobs using private token payloads; no reservation row is fabricated and expired offers are cancelled before provider delivery.
Waitlist candidates are ordered deterministically by temporal compatibility, then insertion time, then id; non-top compatible candidates cannot be offered first.
Public waitlist entry is feature-gated, rate-limited and idempotent without creating a reservation.
